indicator: unchanged etf_ma_breadth_v1: strict close>SMA20/60/120, equal period and stock weights

panels.original_477: constant 477, score null until all have 120 valid calendar sessions
panels.fixed_complete_cohort: subset of current 477 with valid prices on EVERY captured trading session; same constant subset on all dates
panels.eligible_current_pool: subset of current 477 with all 120 required calendar closes available on each date; record changing count; report 80% and 90% coverage sensitivities

reference_distribution: 2020-01-02 through day before target; never include target in its own reference
percentile: midrank = 100*(strictly_lower+0.5*equal)/N; report strict/inclusive bounds for ties

walk_forward.fit: trailing prior 252 sessions, shift one day before threshold; no future observations

stress_proxies.volatility: sample std of 20 daily log returns * sqrt(252), realized not implied
stress_proxies.returns: same-day and trailing 20-session price change; no trading rule optimization

comparisons: Spearman rank association; median stress in low/normal/high walk-forward groups; counts of separate low-score runs; descriptive, no significance claim treating daily observations independent
selection_limit: current constituents and hindsight completeness selection; not historical ETF membership; survival bias remains
